events.title: Demo Coming Soon
events.summary: Really excited to announce that the demo will be coming out later this month! I've been working hard making this experience better thanks to all the feedback received during the playtest (if you participated, you're awesome). Can't wait to get this snapshot in the hands of more hikers.See ya on the trails!Michael

events.title: Playtest 1.0 Ends Today
events.summary: Thank you so muchto everyone who participated in the playtest, shared recordings, filled out the survey and/or sent feedback. I have gotten a tremendous amount of quality feedback about what's working, what isn't, and how I can make Night Hike even better and I'm motivated to make some quality changes as I move into preparations for the demo.If you still haven't given feedback or tried it out, there day is still yours to do so (and you can continue to send me feedback days afterwards) Night Hike

events.title: See me in the Endix Showcase

Endix is a free virtual/digital event built as a game in Unreal Engine, this allows you to join the Showcase on your own terms. Visit Endix on Steam to create your own avatar and jump into a digital theme world, showing tons of beloved and new games that might not have been on your radar yet.
